title: Fashion Cabinet Body Measurement Set
description: The shared measurement contract between Fashion Cabinet (which CONSUMES these numbers to draft flat patterns) and Yantra4D (whose dress-form hyperobject PRODUCES a solid whose measured landmark rings EQUAL them). One versioned source of truth, imported by both repos, so the body and the garment can never disagree about the same person. A measurement set is one body / size: a named collection of ISO-8559 landmark values in millimetres. See docs/strategy/3d-and-the-mannequin.md §3.

landmark_code.description: Canonical ISO-8559 landmark codes. This enum is the vocabulary a garment's parameter `measurement.code` must draw from and the rings a Yantra4D body form must expose. Girths are full-body circumferences; lengths are along the body. All values millimetres. Two legacy spellings seen in early cartridges are NOT canonical and must converge here: `chest_girth` → `chest_bust_girth`; `under_bust_girth` → `underbust_girth`.

measurement_mm.description: One landmark value in millimetres. A bare number is shorthand for {value}. The object form may add an ISO reference and provenance (measured on a person, or a size-chart cell).

iso_8559.description: ISO 8559-1 measurement number, e.g. '4.10' for waist girth

slug.description: Stable id for this measurement set, e.g. 'straight-m-torso', 'child-6y', 'infant-6m'.

kind.description: dress_form = an abstract tailor's bust/form (the recommended starting body — neutral, no uncanny figure); person = a real individual's made-to-measure set; size_preset = a canonical sized template.

demographic.description: Sizing context, not an assertion about any wearer.

size_label.description: Human size name for a preset, e.g. 'M', 'EU 40', '6Y'. Absent for a made-to-measure person.

region.description: Origin of the size system, e.g. 'MX', 'EU', 'US'.

units.description: Millimetres are the only unit in v0 (matches the fc kernel). Present for forward-compatibility; if absent, mm is assumed.

landmarks.description: The measurement values, keyed by canonical landmark code. A set need not carry every landmark — only those a garment or the form needs — but every key present MUST be a canonical code (propertyNames enforces it), so drift is impossible.

posture.description: Optional form/pose hints the Yantra4D dress-form cartridge may honour (a standing form, a low bust point). Advisory in v0; the landmark rings are authoritative.
